title: Ladies Day 2022
subtitle: Southwest Division Ladies Day events of 2022, club by club.

sections.heading: April 20, 2022 Ladies Day at Laguna Woods
body: Thanks to Laguna Woods for hosting our first Ladies Day of the year.  We had Ladies from Casta Del Sol, Hermosa Beach, Laguna Beach, Laguna Woods, Newport Beach and Santa Ana.  Hospitality was fabulous with a wide variety of breakfast items and a beautiful lunch.  It is always so special to have Ladies from various clubs meet and lawn bowl together with others from the Southwest Division.  We also thank SWD for supporting this event throughout the year.
In the morning 12 ends were played  and the winners were:
1st Place:           Jan Hargraves               Nancy Stanek                Carol Petyo
2nd Place:          Maryna Hyland             Amy Capron
3rd Place:         Sandy Graham              Ramona Loucks
4th Place:          Jane Blair                      Tina Larson                   Eleanor Reafsnyder
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place:           Jane Blair                      Tina Larson                   Carol Petyo
2nd Place:          Cynthia Nolan               Charlyn Moltane           Carol Kangas
3rd Place:          Jan Hargraves               Eleanor Reafsnyder       Sophia Chiang
Congratulations to all the winners.
The next Ladies Day is at Long Beach Lawn Bowl Club on  May 18th.
Hope to see you at our next Ladies’ Day.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel
Ladies Day Coordinators

images.alt: The Ladies Day group in whites posed on the green outside the Laguna Woods clubhouse.

sections.heading: May 18th, 2022 Ladies Day at Long Beach
body: Thanks to Long Beach for hosting Ladies Day.  June “Kiwi” Ralph took charge of hospitality and put together wonderful treats for breakfast and lunch salad and goodies were also provided.  Thanks also to Candy DeFazio for helping her and everyone else who was behind the scenes.  We had Ladies from Hermosa Beach LBC, Holmby LBC,  Laguna Beach LBC, Long Beach LBC and  Newport Beach LBC.  Everyone had such a great time bowling.   There were lots of smiles, laughter and of course terrific lawn bowling games.  We also thank SWD for supporting this event throughout the year.
In the morning 12 ends were played  and the winners were:
1st Place:            Candy DeFazio              Nancy Stanek                Connie Delgado
2nd Place:           Norma Goodhart           Claudia Sego                             June Ralph
3rd Place:         Carol Poto                    Sandra Mironesco         Molly Smulian
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place:            Candy DeFazio              Claudia Sego                 Catherine Major
2nd Place tie:       Carol Poto                    Sandra Mironesco         Molly Smulian
2nd Place tie:    Trish Soto                     Linda Bator                   Le Anderson
Congratulations to all the winners.
Hope to see you at our next Ladies’ Day.  We may be changing the date and location so look out for your email giving all this information.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel
Ladies Day Coordinators

images.alt: Bowlers in whites posed outside the Long Beach clubhouse, five seated on the green bank in front.

sections.heading: Ladies Day June 2022
body: Thanks to Santa Monica LBC for hosting Ladies Day.  We had to make a change where to bowl and Santa Monica graciously agreed to host.  Hospitality was wonderful and had a special treat of ice cream cones after our games.

We had Ladies from Beverly Hills LBC, Holmby LBC,  Newport Harbor LBC and Santa Monica LBC.  Our first time ladies attending this Ladies Day were Debbie Gealy (Newport Harbor) and from Santa Monica, Mary Jo Zirbes, Ann Maier, Barbara Wallace, Gina Fitten, Del Arambula, Sandy Nagler, Sally Chateau, Sue Price-McGough, Summer Wedertz and Emma Schmole.  I’m hoping they are all now hooked on Ladies Day and will be returning.
The weather cooperated and we had a beautiful sunny day, as opposed to the rain forecasted.  Thank you everyone for attending.
In the morning 12 ends were played  and the winners were:
1st Place:           Linda Bator                   Claudia Sego                 Holly Gross
2nd Place:          Ann Maier                    Del Arambula
3rd Place tie:    Diana Wenzel               Karen Billon                  Sandy Nagler
3rd Place tie:    Cheryl Barkovich           Debbie Gealy
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place:           Cheryl Barkovich           Karen Billon                  Molly Smulian
2nd Place:          Barbara Wallace            Sandra Mirenesco         Sue Price
3rd Place:          Norma Goodhart           Holly Gross
Congratulations to all the winners.
There will not be a Ladies Day in July   The next Ladies Day is at Newport Harbor LBC on August 17th
Hope to see you at our next Ladies’ Day.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel
Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: Ladies Day August 2022
body: Thank you, Laguna Beach LBC, for hosting Ladies Day and having such a wonderful lunch presentation for everyone.  The greens were wonderful and of course everyone enjoyed lawn bowling with a view of the ocean.

We had a wonderful turnout of 39 ladies with members from Costa del Sol LBC, Holmby LBC, Laguna Beach LBC, Laguna Woods LBC, Long Beach LBC, Newport Harbor LBC and Santa Ana LBC.  We were also honored to have Jolene Beck from Long Beach who just recently retired from lawn bowling after many decades and many medals.
I always love to mention our first time ladies attending which included Phyllis Mitchell from Laguna Beach LBC and Cathy Heriot and Denise La Valle from Long Beach LBC.
In the morning 12 ends were played and the winners were:
1st Place:        Jane Blair                     Christine Adams       Candace Tysdal
2nd Place:       Joanne Hedgespeth   Carol Kangas
3rd Place          Diana Wenzel            Beverly Ponder         Phyllis Mitchell
3rd Place tie:   Julie Buchanan          Holly Gross               Carla Vargas
4th Place:        Shelley Cohen            Karen Billon              Louise Doslu
The afternoon game of 10 ends and the winners were:
1st Place:           Claudia Sego           Holly Gross                Carla Vargas
2nd Place tie      Charlyn Moltane      Karen Billon               Trudy Josephson
2nd Place tie:      Julie Buchanan        Janell Williams           Carol Petyo
2nd Pace tie:       Norma Goodhart      Patty Doidge
3rd Place:           Shelley Cohen          Christine Adams        Denise La Valle
4th Place:           Val Blackholly           Eleanor Reafsnyder   Louise Doslu
4th Place tie:      Cynthia Nolan           Cathy Heriot               Debbie Gealy

We had a very unusual 3 way tie for our 2nd Place and tie game for 4th Place.  Lots of prize money given out thanks to Southwest Division contributing to our prize fund.  Congratulations to all the winners. The next Ladies Day is September 21st at The Groves LBC in Irvine.
Thank you to all the Ladies who participated in this Ladies Day.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel

sections.heading: Ladies Day September 2022
body: A special thank you to The Groves for hosting our Ladies Day.  Mike Porter their VP was so helpful grooming our greens and setting everything up.  We all enjoyed breakfast goodies in the morning and salads and desserts at lunch thanks to hospitality run by Vicky Porter, Cathy MacDonald, Julie Kimura and Suzie Houston.

Ladies day is only successful because of the many loyal ladies who attend.  Thank you all for supporting this activity.  I always hear comments how wonderful it is to meet ladies from other clubs and get the experience of competitive bowling.  This time we had ladies from the following clubs:  Casta del Sol LBC, Holmby LBC, Laguna Beach LBC, Laguna Woods LBC, Long Beach LBC, Newport Harbor LBC, Santa LBC and The Groves LBC.  Again, thank you all.

sections.heading: Ladies Day October 2022 at Casta Del Sol
body: Ladies Day was held at Casta del Sol in Mission Viejo. A special thank you to Butch Nelson for setting up all the rinks and making sure everything was in place for us.  Also thanks to other club members for their hospitality. Besides having breakfast goodies and salads for lunch, I can’t forget to thank them for the ice cream bars which were certainly welcomed after a warm day of bowling. The greens at Casta del Sol were rolled twice for us and great to play on, it was so nice to have them back in the loop.

The following clubs participated in this Ladies Day:  Casta del Sol, The Groves, Hermosa Beach, Holmby, Laguna Beach, Laguna Woods and Newport Harbor.  We were delighted to have one first time Ladies’ Day bowler join us:  Peggy Torrance (Casta del Sol).
In the morning 12 ends were played  and the winners were:
1st Place:           Julie Buchanan              Tina Larson
2nd Place:          Susan Denton               Debbie Gealy                Carol Petyo
3rd Place:         Diana Wenzel               Louise Peralta
4th Place:          Shelley Cohen               Eleanor Reafsnyder       Patty Doidge
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place:           Linda Bator                   Julie Kimura
2nd Place:          Claudia Sego                 Nancy Stanek
3rd Place tie:       Shelley Cohen              Debby Gealy
3rd Place tie:      Susan Denton               Carol Petyo
Congratulations to all the winners.  The next Ladies Day is at Newport Harbor LBC, November 16th.
Ladies’ Day is lots of fun so hope to see you next time.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel
Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: Ladies Day November 2022 - Newport Harbor
body: Ladies Day was held at the Newport Harbor LBC.  A big thank you to the hospitality of Newport Harbor with breakfast items and a great selection for lunch.  Everyone complimented the wonderful food.  The day couldn’t have been more perfect with beautiful weather along with great lady bowlers.  The clubs joining us for the day were Casta del Sol, Holmby LBC, Laguna Beach LBC, Laguna Woods LBC, Long Beach LBC, Newport Harbor LBC, Santa Ana and Santa Anita LBC.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning 12 ends were played  and the winners were:
1st Place:           Margi Rambo                Julie Kimura                  Molly Smulian
2nd Place:          Carla Vigos                    Holly Gross                   Cecilia Tong
3rd Place:         Karen Billon                  Claudia Sego                 Peggy Torrance
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place:           Jane Blair                      Melinda Riddle
2nd Place:          Sheila Conti                  Margaret Butler
3rd Place:            Diana Wenzel               Debby Gealy                 Kiwi Ralph
Congratulations to all the winners.

Our next Ladies Day will be our Holiday Luncheon and one game of lawn bowling.  Anyone can choose to bowl and have lunch or simply show up for the luncheon.  Please check for the signup sheets and payment information which will be posted at your club.
Laguna Woods on Dec 20, 2021.  Please see this is a Tuesday – not our normal Wednesday.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

images.alt: The group posed under the Newport Harbor Lawn Bowling sign, a service dog in a yellow vest at the front.

sections.heading: Ladies Day Holiday Luncheon December 2022 - Laguna Woods
body: What a fabulous day to have our last Ladies Day of 2022.  Laguna Woods set up wonderful hospitality for our morning lawn bowling game.  The weather was spectacular and everyone enjoyed a 12 end game of lawn bowling.  It is always so much fun to mix ladies from several clubs throughout the SW Division and enjoy bowling together.

After bowling we enjoyed a fun filled luncheon with a great buffet lunch.  A special thanks to Sheila Conti for arranging everything for this luncheon.  Everyone brings a wrapped gift and we had a raffle to win the gifts.  All funds raised are donated to SW Division to support our Ladies Day throughout the year.  This year we also had a separate raffle for a handmade holiday quilt made by Heather Stewart.  Heather donated this to raise more money for our SW Division.  This was a huge success and definitely raised extra money for us.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning 12 ends were played  and the winners were:
1st Place:           Heather Stewart           Mary Jane Swee
2nd Place:          Joan Robbins                Norma Goodhart           Carol Novick
3rd Place:         Linda Roberts                Susan Denton               Joanne Narmontas
Congratulations to all the winners.

We hope everyone has a beautiful holiday season and a very Happy New Year.  We will be sending out notices to see which clubs will be able to host a Ladies Day in 2023 (March – November).  So until March 2023 keep bowling and smiling.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators
